title: Distance between powers of 2 and powers of 3
notes: MathOverflow 116840 (2012). Records the elementary observation that if 2^t is unusually close to a 3-power, then 2^{t+1} sits in the middle of the neighboring 3-powers and is substantially farther away; also the standard Matveev-shape lower bound |2^p-3^q| >= max(2^p,3^q)/(e max(p,q))^C. The neighbor relation here is an exponent shift by 1, not a continued-fraction fan step Q. Cited as the separation geometry behind Attack A; the Phase-0 probe tests whether a Juggler cycle actually forces two exponent-neighbor approximations.
